added_lines: Christmas Concert A Festive Evening of Christmas Song Our Lady Crowned Church Friday, 11th December 2026 at 7.00 pm Featuring Our Lady Crowned Church Choir and Guests Conducted by Mr Michael Joyce Tickets: €10 Children go free Enjoy a raffle with great prizes. Tickets are now available from the Parish Office, also before and after Sunday Masses, and on the night. Christmas Concert Fundraiser Our Lady Crowned Church Choir and guests invite you to a festive concert on Friday, 11th December 2026 at 7.00pm in Our Lady Crowned Church. All proceeds will support local clubs and organisations that provide services and opportunities for young people in the Mayfield area, including sports clubs and youth organisations. Groups wishing to be considered for a share of the funds should apply in writing to Fr Charlie, at Our Lady Crowned Church. Please include details of your work with young people and your organisation’s contact information. Closing Date: Monday, 7th December at 12 noon. Helping Families in Bethlehem & Palestine this Christmas On the first and second Sundays of Advent, our three churches will hold a fundraiser in conjunction with Trócaire. Handmade olive wood Christmas decorations, crafted by skilled artisans in Bethlehem and nearby communities, will be available for €5 each. Your donation will help sustain livelihoods during this time of conflict, when many families have lost their regular work. Please support the people of Bethlehem. Your help is greatly appreciated. Amen. Welcome to Fr Marius O’Reilly We warmly welcome Fr Marius O’Reilly, Diocesan Vocations Director, who will join us at all Masses this weekend in Our Lady Crowned Church and St Joseph’s Church.
He will speak about his role in promoting vocations and supporting those who are discerning their calling.

Youth Ministry Second Collection 14th & 15th November 2026 The second collection this weekend will support the work of Sheila Kelleher, Diocesan Youth Ministry Coordinator, and the volunteers who help young people grow in faith and take part in parish life.

Your generosity supports initiatives across the Diocese, including Alpha Youth, Maranatha, altar server and young adult formation, Connect, youth-led Masses, and pilgrimages to Lourdes and World Youth Day Seoul 2027. Thank you for supporting our young people and the future of the Church.
